sentences: For the first time in history more people live in towns than in the country.
In Britain this has had a curious result.

While polls show Britons rate "the countryside" alongside the royal family, Shakespeare and the National Health Service (NHS) as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.
translations: 历史上第一次，居住在城市的人口超过了农村。
在英国，这产生了一个奇怪的结果。
尽管民调显示，英国人将“乡村”与王室、莎士比亚和国民健康服务体系（NHS）并列为最令他们为国家感到自豪的事物，但这在政治上得到的支持却有限。

sentences: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save "the beauty of natural places for everyone forever."
It was specifically to provide city dwellers with spaces for leisure where they could experience "a refreshing air."
Hill's pressure later led to the creation of national parks and green belts.
They don't make countryside any more, and every year concrete consumes more of it.
It needs constant guardianship.
translations: 一个世纪前，奥克塔维亚·希尔发起国家信托基金，不是为了拯救时尚住宅，而是为了“为所有人永远保存自然之地的美景”。
其目的明确是为城市居民提供休闲空间，让他们能体验到“清新的空气”。
希尔的努力后来促成了国家公园和绿化带的建立。
乡村已无法再生，而每年都有更多的乡村被混凝土吞噬。
它需要持续的守护。

sentences: At the next election none of the big parties seem likely to endorse this sentiment.
The Conservatives' planning reform explicitly gives rural development priority over conservation, even authorising "off-plan" building where local people might object.
The concept of sustainable development has been defined as profitable.
Labour likewise wants to discontinue local planning where councils oppose development.
The Liberal Democrats are silent.
Only Ukip, sensing its chance, has sided with those pleading for a more considered approach to using green land.
Its Campaign to Protect Rural England struck terror into many local Conservative parties.
translations: 在下一次选举中，似乎没有一个大党会支持这种观点。
保守党的规划改革明确将农村发展置于环境保护之上，甚至授权在可能遭到当地人反对的地方进行“计划外”建设。
可持续发展的概念已被定义为有利可图。
工党同样希望终止地方议会反对开发地区的规划。
自由民主党则保持沉默。
只有英国独立党（Ukip）嗅到机会，站在了那些呼吁以更审慎方式使用绿地的人一边。
其“保护英格兰乡村”运动令许多地方保守党感到恐惧。

sentences: The sensible place to build new houses, factories and offices is where people are, in cities and towns where infrastructure is in place.
The London agents Stirling Ackroyd recently identified enough sites for half a million houses in the London area alone, with no intrusion on green belt.
What is true of London is even truer of the provinces.
translations: 建造新住宅、工厂和办公室的合理位置是人口聚集的地方，即基础设施完善的城市和城镇。
伦敦的房地产中介斯特林·阿克罗伊德最近仅在伦敦地区就确定了足以建造五十万套住房的地块，且不侵占绿化带。
伦敦如此，外省更是如此。

sentences: The idea that "housing crisis" equals "concreted meadows" is pure lobby talk.
The issue is not the need for more houses but, as always, where to put them.
Under lobby pressure, George Osborne favours rural new-build against urban renovation and renewal.
He favours out-of-town shopping sites against high streets.
This is not a free market but a biased one.
Rural towns and villages have grown and will always grow.
They do so best where building sticks to their edges and respects their character.
We do not ruin urban conservation areas.
Why ruin rural ones?
translations: 认为“住房危机”等同于“草地被混凝土覆盖”的说法纯粹是游说集团的言论。
问题不在于是否需要更多住房，而一如既往地在于将它们建在哪里。
在游说集团的压力下，乔治·奥斯本支持农村新建，而非城市翻新和改造。
他支持在城外购物中心而非商业街。
这不是自由市场，而是一个有偏见的市场。
乡村城镇和村庄已经发展，并将永远发展。
当建筑局限于其边缘并尊重其特色时，它们才能最好地发展。
我们不会破坏城市保护区。
为什么要破坏乡村保护区呢？

sentences: Development should be planned, not let rip.
After the Netherlands, Britain is Europe's most crowded country.
Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living.
There is no doubt of the alternative – the corrupted landscapes of southern Portugal, Spain or Ireland.
Avoiding this rather than promoting it should unite the left and right of the political spectrum.
translations: 发展应有规划，而非放任自流。
继荷兰之后，英国是欧洲最拥挤的国家。
半个世纪的城乡规划使其得以保持令人羡慕的乡村连贯性，同时仍允许低密度的城市生活。
另一种选择毫无疑问——那就是葡萄牙南部、西班牙或爱尔兰被破坏的景观。
避免而非促进这种情况，应该能让政治光谱上的左翼和右翼团结起来。

sentences:
26. Britain's public sentiment about the countryside____
A. is not well reflected in politics.
B. is fully backed by the royal family.
C. didn't start till the Shakespearean age.
D. has brought much benefit to the NHS.
translations:
26. 英国公众对乡村的情绪____
A. 在政治上没有得到很好的体现。
B. 得到了王室的全力支持。
C. 直到莎士比亚时代才开始。
D. 给国民健康服务体系带来了很多好处。

sentences:
27. According to Paragraph 2, the achievements of the National Trust are now being____
A. largely overshadowed.
B. properly protected.
C. effectively reinforced.
D. gradually destroyed.
translations:
27. 根据第二段，国家信托基金的成就现在正被____
A. 在很大程度上被掩盖。
B. 得到妥善保护。
C. 得到有效加强。
D. 逐渐被摧毁。

sentences:
28. Which of the following can be inferred from Paragraph 3?
A. Labour is under attack for opposing development.
B. The Conservatives may abandon "off-plan" building.
C. Ukip may gain from its support for rural conservation.
D. The Liberal Democrats are losing political influence.
translations:
28. 从第三段可以推断出以下哪项？
A. 工党因反对开发而受到攻击。
B. 保守党可能会放弃“计划外”建设。
C. 英国独立党可能因其对乡村保护的支持而获益。
D. 自由民主党正在失去政治影响力。

sentences:
29. The author holds that George Osborne's preference____
A. shows his disregard for the character of rural areas.
B. stresses the necessity of easing the housing crisis.
C. highlights his firm stand against lobby pressure.
D. reveals a strong prejudice against urban areas.
translations:
29. 作者认为乔治·奥斯本的偏好____
A. 表明他对乡村特色的漠视。
B. 强调缓解住房危机的必要性。
C. 突显了他反对游说压力的坚定立场。
D. 揭示了对城市地区的强烈偏见。

sentences:
30. In the last paragraph, the author shows his appreciation of____
A. the size of population in Britain.
B. the enviable urban lifestyle in Britain.
C. the town-and-country planning in Britain.
D. the political life in today's Britain.
translations:
30. 在最后一段中，作者表达了对____的赞赏。
A. 英国的人口规模。
B. 英国令人羡慕的城市生活方式。
C. 英国的城乡规划。
D. 当今英国的政治生活。
